PASSCODE GATE: enforced both in the instruction (constraint) and defensively in cancel_alarm / put_account_on_test (they check passcode_verified in _resolved_account and refuse otherwise).

DURATION: put_account_on_test accepts duration_minutes (int, normalized by the agent) + duration_label (str for read-back); enforces 30-480 min range per TDD edge-case policy. Used int default 0 (not None) per platform tool-param rules.
OPERATOR TRANSFER is simulated via instruction text only (agent states the transfer, then end_session) -- no transfer_to_agent tool, consistent with the single-agent design.
The mock dataset is duplicated in lookup_accounts_by_caller and verify_passcode (each tool is self-contained in the GECX sandbox). Keep the two copies in sync if edited.
